decision_contract.PASS: material and reachable consumer proves current governed contract identity plus receiver currentness/readback
decision_contract.HOLD: consumer is not currently materially reachable or is intentionally disabled; history is retained but cannot authorize continuation
decision_contract.BLOCK: material reachable effect lacks current identity/readback, has stale authorizing projection/cache, or has UNKNOWN required capability
decision_contract.UNKNOWN: blocks only the dependent material consumer/effect; it must not globally block unrelated non-applicable consumers

drain_criteria.retire_rule: RETIRE/CUTOVER may be considered only when all numeric blockers above are zero at the cutover readback and negative tests pass on that exact candidate; historical V1 rows/artifacts remain readable and non-authorizing.
